name: membership-results-beside-exists-filter
sql: SELECT o.id, o.a IN (SELECT i.x FROM inner_rows i WHERE i.k=o.k AND i.enabled=1), o.a NOT IN (SELECT i.x FROM inner_rows i WHERE i.k=o.k AND i.enabled=1) FROM outer_rows o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outer_rows w WHERE w.id>=o.id) ORDER BY o.id;

name: row-membership-results-beside-exists-filter
sql: SELECT o.id, (o.a,o.b) IN (SELECT i.x,i.y FROM inner_rows i WHERE i.k=o.k AND i.enabled=1), (o.a,o.b) NOT IN (SELECT i.x,i.y FROM inner_rows i WHERE i.k=o.k AND i.enabled=1) FROM outer_rows o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outer_rows w WHERE w.id>=o.id) ORDER BY o.id;

name: membership-results-empty-right
sql: SELECT o.id, o.a IN (SELECT i.x FROM inner_rows i WHERE i.k=o.k AND i.enabled=1 AND i.enabled=999), o.a NOT IN (SELECT i.x FROM inner_rows i WHERE i.k=o.k AND i.enabled=1 AND i.enabled=999) FROM outer_rows o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outer_rows w WHERE w.id>=o.id) ORDER BY o.id;

name: membership-results-preserve-duplicate-rows
sql: SELECT o.k, o.a IN (SELECT i.x FROM inner_rows i WHERE i.k=o.k AND i.enabled=1) FROM outer_rows o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outer_rows w WHERE w.id>=o.id) ORDER BY o.k,o.a;

name: membership-results-parent-order-and-limit
sql: SELECT o.id, (o.a,o.b) NOT IN (SELECT i.x,i.y FROM inner_rows i WHERE i.k=o.k AND i.enabled=1) FROM outer_rows o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outer_rows w WHERE w.id>=o.id) ORDER BY o.id DESC LIMIT 3 OFFSET 1;

name: membership-results-inner-order-and-limit
sql: SELECT o.id, o.a IN (SELECT i.x FROM inner_rows i WHERE i.k=o.k AND i.enabled=1 ORDER BY i.x DESC LIMIT 1) FROM outer_rows o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outer_rows w WHERE w.id>=o.id) ORDER BY o.id;

name: membership-results-distinct
sql: SELECT DISTINCT o.k, o.a, o.a IN (SELECT i.x FROM inner_rows i WHERE i.k=o.k AND i.enabled=1) FROM outer_rows o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outer_rows w WHERE w.id>=o.id) ORDER BY o.k,o.a;

name: membership-results-shared-right
sql: WITH c AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT k,x FROM inner_rows WHERE enabled=1) SELECT o.id, o.a IN (SELECT c.x FROM c WHERE c.k=o.k) FROM outer_rows o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outer_rows w WHERE w.id>=o.id) ORDER BY o.id;

name: membership-results-column-collation
sql: SELECT o.id, o.k IN (SELECT i.k FROM typed_inner i WHERE i.grp=o.grp), o.k NOT IN (SELECT i.k FROM typed_inner i WHERE i.grp=o.grp) FROM typed_outer o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM typed_outer w WHERE w.id>=o.id) ORDER BY o.id;

name: membership-results-right-explicit-collation
sql: SELECT o.id, o.k IN (SELECT i.k COLLATE NOCASE FROM typed_inner i WHERE i.grp=o.grp), o.k NOT IN (SELECT i.k COLLATE NOCASE FROM typed_inner i WHERE i.grp=o.grp) FROM typed_outer o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM typed_outer w WHERE w.id>=o.id) ORDER BY o.id;

name: membership-results-left-computed-collation
sql: SELECT o.id, o.k||'' IN (SELECT i.k FROM typed_inner i WHERE i.grp=o.grp), o.k||'' NOT IN (SELECT i.k FROM typed_inner i WHERE i.grp=o.grp) FROM typed_outer o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM typed_outer w WHERE w.id>=o.id) ORDER BY o.id;

name: exists-results-beside-exists-filter
sql: SELECT o.a, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2 i WHERE i.x>o.a), NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2 i WHERE i.x>o.a) FROM t1 o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t1 w WHERE w.a>=o.a) ORDER BY o.a;

name: exists-results-ignore-output-evaluation
sql: SELECT o.a, EXISTS (SELECT abs(-9223372036854775808) FROM t2 i WHERE i.x>o.a), NOT EXISTS (SELECT random() FROM t2 i WHERE i.x>o.a) FROM t1 o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t1 w WHERE w.a>=o.a) ORDER BY o.a;

name: exists-results-limit-zero
sql: SELECT o.a, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2 i WHERE i.x>o.a LIMIT 0), NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2 i WHERE i.x>o.a LIMIT 0) FROM t1 o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t1 w WHERE w.a>=o.a) ORDER BY o.a;

name: exists-results-inner-offset-and-duplicates
sql: SELECT o.a, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2 i WHERE i.x=o.a LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1) FROM t1 o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t1 w WHERE w.a>=o.a) ORDER BY o.a;

name: exists-results-preserve-outer-nulls-and-duplicates
sql: SELECT o.k, o.tag, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inner_rows i WHERE i.k IS o.k), NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inner_rows i WHERE i.k=o.k) FROM outer_rows o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outer_rows w WHERE w.k IS o.k) ORDER BY o.tag;
